appropriate_uses: Israeli and regional professional reporting, especially Israeli official-position access, Israeli security framing, and reported regional reactions.
inappropriate_uses: Treating Israeli official or U.S. ambassador claims as independent proof, or treating liveblog summaries as full upstream reporting when they cite other outlets.
known_failure_modes: Israeli security-state proximity; liveblog compression; dependence on U.S. and Israeli official claims; regional conflict framing.
name: The Times of Israel
observables: Israeli official statements, regional security claims, reported intelligence-attribution claims, and public diplomatic positioning
originating_chain_rule: Treat each Times of Israel item as one chain; liveblog references to WSJ, Fox, or other outlets do not create independent lineage for those upstream claims.

review_history.note: Added for VER-20260813-01 to capture a regional report carrying Israeli-warning confirmation and caveats around credibility and denial.
